_about: Parker 2017 supplement-1 abbreviation -> site breed id, Wikidata QID, FCI number. Drafted with Claude Code on 2026-11-04 from the sources below; every entry is reviewed=false until Paul checks it. Size varieties share one id and carry a variant (Paul, 2026-11-04). Ids are slugs of the usual English name. Doubts are listed per entry, never resolved silently. Extended to the full Parker 2017 breed set with Claude Code on 2026-11-09: the new entries are drafts (reviewed=false), see data/reports/review.md.

sources.citation: Parker et al. 2017, Cell Reports 19(4):697-708, supplement 1 (data/raw/parker2017-s1.csv)
Unofficial FCI nomenclature export, paiv/fci-breeds, commit 88aaca5c0726b2a4c6cf6aa06a1ffb359f9262f2 (data/raw/fci-breeds/)
Wikidata, query and date in data/raw/wikidata-breeds.json

entries.basis: Parker "Akita" attached to FCI 344 "AMERICAN AKITA" (Paul, 2026-11-04). Inferred, not written in the article: 152 of the 161 Parker breeds are AKC breeds, samples were collected by NHGRI (US) at dog events and by mail, and the COO column of supplement 1 (dogs collected in the country of origin) is empty for AKIT, so the 10 dogs were collected in the US. Q37534 "American Akita" found by label search: it carries no FCI catalogue code on Wikidata.
doubts: Parker never says whether its Akitas are of the Japanese or the American type: the attachment to 344 is an inference.
FCI country of 344 is JAPAN; Wikidata Q37534 P495 is United States.

alternatives.note: Akita (Japanese type), same name as Parker

Parker "Brussels Griffon" closest to FCI 80 "GRIFFON BRUXELLOIS". Q38889 "Griffon Bruxellois" found by label search ("Brussels Griffon" leads to it).
doubts: Kept on FCI 80 only (Paul, 2026-11-04); 81 and 82 stay as alternatives because the coat of the 2 dogs is unknown.
The FCI splits this dog into three breeds: 80 Griffon bruxellois, 81 Griffon belge, 82 Petit brabançon (section "Small Belgian Dogs"). The AKC "Brussels Griffon" covers the three coats.
Wikidata Q38889 carries the three FCI codes 080, 081 and 082 at once, while Q38055 (Griffon belge) and Q13631411 (Petit brabançon) exist as separate items without FCI code.

doubts: Variant label "pomeranian" is the Parker (AKC) name; the FCI standard names this size Zwergspitz / Pomeranian.
